fpc-rome-ga-epc.assessment: First Presbyterian Church of Rome, Georgia is a historic 175-year EPC congregation led by Senior Pastor Rev. Jeff Chadwick — whose credentials are among the strongest profiled here: B.S. Berry College, M.Div. from Reformed Theological Seminary, and D.Min. from Westminster Theological Seminary (2022). The combination of RTS + Westminster training suggests a deep confessional Reformed commitment and an expository preaching ministry. The church offers a traditional 9:00 AM Sanctuary service, 10:05 Sunday School, and 11:00 AM Combined Worship in King Hall. Active Wednesday night dinner/groups programming for all ages. Standard EPC caveat on women-elder policy (verify Presbytery of the Southeast stance and local session). Strong green-eligible option for the Rome, Georgia area.

fpc-thomasville-ga-epc.assessment: First Presbyterian Church of Thomasville is an EPC congregation in south Georgia led by Senior Pastor Dr. Tim Filston. Pastor Filston grew up in North Carolina and has previously served churches in Houston, Orlando, and Chattanooga. He maintains a public theology blog at faithanddoubt.com, suggesting an accessible, pastoral approach to theological questions. He and his wife Beth have four children. The church's staff page describes him as 'preacher, teacher, and leader' — the traditional Presbyterian Word-and-sacrament ministry frame. Standard EPC caveat on women-elder policy (verify Presbytery of the Southeast stance). Solid green-eligible confessional Reformed option in south Georgia.
